title: Are Smarter LLMs Safer? Exploring Safety-Reasoning Trade-offs in Prompting and Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the trade-off between reasoning capabilities (benchmarked via GSM8K) and safety (benchmarked via HarmBench and TrustLLM). While safety evaluation includes refusal of harmful/unethical content, the study does not focus on or benchmark religious beliefs, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems beyond general jailbreak safety and privacy.
